key_path: Sign up at notion.so with Google/Apple OAuth (or email + 6-digit login code)
Agent installs CLI: curl -fsSL https://ntn.dev | bash; run 'ntn login' (browser authorize) -> CLI can make API calls ('ntn api v1/users')
Alternative raw token: Developer portal https://www.notion.so/developers/tokens > create Personal Access Token (name, workspace, capabilities: Notion API / Workers)
Call GET https://api.notion.com/v1/users/me with Bearer PAT + Notion-Version: 2026-03-11
human_gates_notes: Email code avoided with Google OAuth. Workspace PAT creation policy can block members; MCP connections can be disabled/revoked by workspace owners. Legacy internal integrations still require sharing each page with the bot (PATs remove that).

agent_native_auth.cli_device_login: yes - 'ntn login' browser flow, creds in system keychain
agent_native_auth.mcp_oauth_dcr: yes - mcp.notion.com /register (RFC 7591) and client_id_metadata_document_supported=true; docs have 'Build an MCP client' DCR guide
agent_native_auth.personal_access_tokens: yes - new user-scoped PATs act as the creator, no per-page sharing needed
agent_native_auth.scoped_tokens: partial - PAT capabilities (Notion API, Workers); internal connections have content capabilities
agent_native_auth.management_api_mints_keys: partial - OAuth token create/introspect/revoke/refresh endpoints; Admin API to list/revoke members' MCP connections; enterprise-managed auth via IdP ID-JAG for MCP tokens

remote.auth: OAuth 2.0 + PKCE with DCR (resource_name 'Notion MCP (Beta)'); enterprise ID-JAG exchange

mcp.local: open-source notion-mcp-server exists but docs say it is no longer actively maintained
mcp.type: product MCP (plus Notion Skills via MCP)
mcp.one_click_install: copy-paste commands for Claude Code/Codex/Cursor; Claude Code plugin (makenotion/claude-code-notion-plugin)
mcp.chatgpt_directory: yes (Notion connector in ChatGPT) - not re-verified

docs_for_agents.markdown_pages: yes - every page has .md variant with an agent-directed 'Documentation Index' header
docs_for_agents.agents_md_or_rules: MCP security best practices page; Notion Skills

score_justification: 2026 overhaul: CLI with browser login, user-scoped PATs, DCR remote MCP, llms.txt + llms-full + OpenAPI + .md pages.
best_practice: Every .md doc page begins with a pointer telling agents to fetch llms.txt first, and PATs eliminated the old 'share every page with your integration' trap.
biggest_gap: Remote MCP is OAuth-only (no PAT bearer documented) and still labelled Beta in its resource metadata; local server abandoned.
